patterns.not_admitting: Starts:\s*(This programme is not offered to new students|Not offered to new students(?:.|\n){0,40}?)\s*(?:Key semester dates|Fees|\.)

config.notes: AUT course pages (www.aut.ac.nz/study/study-options/<area>/courses/<slug> and www.aut.ac.nz/courses/<slug>) carry a Key facts panel: "Programme code: AKxxxx Level: N Points: N Duration: ... Campus: ... Starts: 22 Feb 2027 12 Jul 2027 Key semester dates Fees Domestic $.. (for N points) (...) International [2026 fee:] $.. (for N points) ($N tuition fees + $N student services levy)", then "English language requirements IELTS (Academic) 6.5 overall with all bands 6.0 or higher". Fee = international tuition (student services levy excluded) only when stated for 120 points (one full-time year); where two years are printed the first (2026) line is read and its year kept; 60/180/240-point figures, per-major split figures (e.g. "Computing: $..") and "Not offered to new students" lines are not read. Level = NZQF level (kept as aqf_level, testing only). not_admitting = "Starts: This programme is not offered to new students". Arion (arion.aut.ac.nz) paper/qualification pages, online.aut.ac.nz pages and old PDF programme guides carry none of these. Semester dates: https://www.aut.ac.nz/study/semester-dates (S1 = February, S2 = July, Summer School = November); business professional masters trimesters: https://www.aut.ac.nz/study/semester-dates/business-professional-masters-programmes-dates (T1 = March, T2 = June, T3 = October).
